generations.description: Modern Chrysler 300 / 300C on the LX rear-wheel-drive platform shared with Dodge Charger / Magnum. 5.7L Hemi (300C) and 6.1L Hemi (SRT8) variants are the enthusiast-focused trims. Strong aftermarket for suspension, exhaust, and supercharger kits. Final US MY 2010 before LD redesign.
Refreshed Chrysler 300 / 300C on the LD platform (LX evolution). Continued 5.7L Hemi and 6.4L Hemi (SRT8 / SRT) variants. Final US MY 2023 before discontinuation.
Retro-styled compact wagon on the PT platform. Naturally aspirated 2.4L I4 base; 2.4L turbo (GT) variant offered. Final US MY 2010.
Mid-size sedan replacing the Sebring on the JS platform. 2.4L I4 and 3.6L Pentastar V6. Final US MY 2014 before redesign.
Second-generation Chrysler 200 on the CUSW platform. 2.4L Tigershark I4 standard, 3.6L Pentastar V6 optional. Discontinued; final US MY 2017.
Chrysler-badged Mitsubishi Starion sold in the US under the Conquest name. 2.6L turbo I4 (G54B). Rear-wheel-drive sport coupe popular with the Mitsubishi tuning community. Final US MY 1989.
